notes.title: 🎉 The Music Festival DLC is Out Now! 🎶Plus a Mini Words Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/43160692fda946210ccfacf50e404c8ba30638f6.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that the [b]Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC[/b] is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. Explore themed stages, cozy camping spots, a dazzling Ferris wheel, and much more — all illustrated by Katia Numakura and set to a chill, festive soundtrack by Tatyana Jacques.

👉 Add it to your game and keep the celebration going!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802160/Meow_Moments_Music_Festival/

[h1]🎮 Mini Words Gets an Update Too![/h1]
That’s not all!
We’ve just released a new update for our word puzzle game, [b]Mini Words[/b] 🎉

🕹️ Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller
☁️ Steam Cloud Enabled – keep your progress across devices

If you enjoy relaxed logic word games, it’s a great time to check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158290/Mini_Words__minimalist_puzzle/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/828263e2b7a80914de85a50656214af06ef90ce6.png[/img]

Thank you for supporting our cozy games! We hope you enjoy this new DLC and the updates across our catalog.

notes.title: Update! New control options and improved camera
notes.content:
Hi, in this update we implemented new [b]Gamepad and Keyboard controls and improved camera controls.[/b]

In addition to the current mouse controls, now you have the option to use a gamepad or the keyboard to navigate the menus, build the island, and to freely rotate and move the camera. Try it!

After the release of this game, we developed Island Cities, where we implemented improved gameplay and camera controls using mouse and keyboard. Then, by porting it to Nintendo Switch, we also implemented required gamepad controls.
So, we brought this option to the Island Farmer players on Steam too. Steam Deck players will greatly benefit from it. 
We hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036836/10260e7800b30eef3b9deda1415fa0ba5421ff4e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036836/c3bd0b9852aa1afaf9903e61106a2a3af388189a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036836/575faac9c859bd40b6ecc2758850204bd4763a14.jpg[/img]

Island Farmer is now available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, Stove Indie, and soon on Epic Games Store. We could reach that thanks to the support from players like you!

If you enjoyed Island Farmer, we think you'll enjoy Island Cities:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093900/Island_Cities__Jigsaw_Puzzle/

Follow our Steam developer's page to keep track of our updates:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

notes.title: Happy Holidays update: two new islands! 🏝️🏝️
notes.content:
Celebrating the holidays, we are expanding the recently created evening archipelago with two additional islands.
We were inspired by the great feedback and suggestions from you players! Feel free to post your ideas in the community hub. We might consider them for future updates.

This update is free for everyone. It also includes:
- a fix to some localization problems, mainly in Russian. 
- a new option to restore previous progress based on Steam achievements.
Thanks for the feedback.

We hope you enjoy it!
Thank you so much for being with us this year. We wish happy holidays to you and your beloved ones!

notes.title: Update: the beginning of a new archipelago! 🏝️🏝️ Plus: six languages
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036836/fa368127f34e1442e2436346c023864e0d3ef1f2.jpg[/img]

You asked, and we started to sail in unexplored waters, starting a new archipelago with new islands. 🏝️🏝️
This new setting is located under the evening light, where the waters take on a new magical color. 🌅
We hope you like it, let us know what you think on our community forum!

This update presents four new islands. We plan to expand the new archipelago soon, with new islands to be discovered.

The update also includes localization to six languages: German, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, French, and Italian.

notes.title: Small update released
notes.content:
Hi, farmers!
Thanks for playing Island Farmer!

We've just released an update with these changes:
- Options Menu included in the Main Menu;
- User interface adjustable to different screen resolutions;
- New option to select the intensity of the sparkle effect for the correct blocks.

We've made the changes thanks to your suggestions and feedback. They are very welcome.

Regards.
